SPIRE1-FORM_STANCE_MODIFIER.title: Stance Forms
SPIRE1-FORM_STANCE_MODIFIER.description: Only this custom run uses form stances. Watcher Calm becomes Void and Serpent, Wrath becomes Demon and Reaper, and Divinity becomes Echo and Celestial. Original Wrath/Divinity damage multipliers are replaced, not stacked. Native stance cards and stance-change synergies are preserved. Requires a compatible Watcher mod. Ordinary runs are unchanged.
